renderer: MenuDocumentView with production guest styles, mounted by the local Vite accessibility harness
method: CUA browser UI: select each actual design and appearance, set viewport, change root text size using the fixture control, then inspect rendered DOM geometry and computed styles.
fixture: long-content: 11 items; long restaurant, section and item names; a long price label; unavailable item and dietary notes; two and three price variants, including 200.50.

interaction.keyboardPath: Search with no results → Tab → Enter on first section button
interaction.destinationName: Seasonal favorites from our neighborhood producers

reproducedDefects: Atelier price overlapped a long item name at 800 and 1280 px with enlarged text.
Section navigation scrolled without moving keyboard focus.
Fixed pixel font sizes did not consistently follow root text enlargement.
limits: Text enlargement was exercised through a local fixture control setting root font size to 200%, not through each browser's native text settings.
Computed text contrast and accessible roles do not establish full WCAG conformance.
Actual screen-reader speech, physical-device/browser coverage, physical print proofs and owner trials remain open.
